summary: How to get into your dashboard, and what to do if you forget your password.
content:
## Sign in

1. Go to your website's address and add `/admin` to the end.
2. Enter your **Email** and **Password**.
3. Select **Sign in**.

Turn on **Keep me signed in** on your own computer or phone. Leave it off on a shared computer, such as the one at the host stand.

## Forgot your password?

1. On the sign-in page, select **Forgot Password?**
2. Enter your email address.
3. Open the email that arrives and follow the link.

Nothing in your inbox after 10 minutes? Check your spam folder, then text me.

## Give each person their own login

Please don't share one login between staff. If a new manager needs access, text me their name and email address and I'll set them up.
title: Sign in and reset your password
author: Sam Keller
